Also, can you calculate the speed of a bicycle that traveled a distance of 1000 meters in 200 seconds and provide the answer in m/s? Lastly, can you calculate the speed of a train that traveled a distance of 10000 meters in 600 seconds and provide the answer in km/h?"

to_unit.description: The unit in which the speed should be calculated, default is m/s.
